name: yuanbao_proto_decode_msg_content
notes: Yuanbao protobuf MsgContent decoding: drives the REAL src/hermes_cli/yuanbao_proto_helpers.c::yuanbao_proto_decode_msg_content (linked via extra_src with lib/libjson) against LIVE gateway/platforms/yuanbao_proto.py::_decode_msg_content. Inputs are hex-encoded protobuf probes (empty, string fields, varints incl. zero-varint skips, field-999 ext_map). Ladder: nonempty guard + canonical sorted-key content V event. KNOWN PARITY GAP (documented; image/sound inputs DROPPED): the C port does not decode repeated field 8 (image_info_array) nor string field 7 (sound); LIVE returns {'image_info_array':[...]} where C returns {}. Those probes were excluded from this gate; the missing image/sound handling is a real port gap worth a follow-up fix in yuanbao_proto_helpers.c.
